question: How many days do I have to request a refund for a fee?
expected_answer: Fee refunds can be requested within 60 days of the charge.

question: Are third-party ATM operator fees refundable?
expected_answer: No. ATM fees charged by third-party ATM operators are not refundable by Kestrel Pay.

question: How many goodwill refunds can I get per year?
expected_answer: At most 3 goodwill refunds per calendar year.

question: I see a card payment I don't recognise. What should I do first?
expected_answer: Freeze the card immediately in the app (Cards → Freeze), then report fraud via Help → Report fraud.

question: How long do I have to open a card dispute?
expected_answer: Within 120 days of the transaction date.

question: When do I get a provisional credit after reporting fraud?
expected_answer: Within 2 business days while the investigation runs.

question: What is the FX markup on the Plus plan?
expected_answer: 0.5% (plus an extra 0.5% on weekends between Friday 23:00 and Sunday 23:00 CET).

question: How much does it cost to replace a lost card on the Basic plan?
expected_answer: €7 for lost or damaged cards on Basic (free for fraud cases).

question: If I upgrade from Basic to Premium, when does it take effect?
expected_answer: Upgrades take effect immediately.

question: Will Kestrel Pay ever ask me for my CVV?
expected_answer: No. Staff will never ask for your PIN, full card number, CVV or one-time passcodes.

question: I lost my phone. How do I protect my account?
expected_answer: Log in on the web at app.kestrelpay.example and choose Lock all devices; sessions are revoked within 60 seconds.

question: I paid a Premium fee and downgraded 10 days into the cycle. Do I get money back?
expected_answer: Yes, the Premium fee is refunded pro rata when downgrading within the first 14 days of a billing cycle.

question: Are refunds unlimited and instant?
expected_answer: No. Reviews take up to 3 business days, approved refunds arrive within 5 business days, and goodwill refunds are limited to 3 per year.

question: How long do partner merchant settlements take?
expected_answer: 2 business days (T+2).

question: How many days per week do I need to be in the office?
expected_answer: At least 2 days per week, chosen with your team.

question: How long can I work from another country?
expected_answer: Up to 30 days per calendar year; longer stays need a tax and legal review requested 6 weeks in advance.

question: What is the hotel limit for a trip to Paris?
expected_answer: €250 per night (Paris is one of the exceptions to the €180 limit).

question: What is my yearly learning budget?
expected_answer: €1,200 per year per employee.

question: How many unused vacation days can I carry over, and until when?
expected_answer: Up to 5 days, which expire on 31 March.

question: How long is parental leave for the primary caregiver?
expected_answer: 20 weeks fully paid.

question: Can I deploy to production on a Friday afternoon?
expected_answer: No, there is a deploy freeze on Fridays after 15:00 CET (and the last 3 business days of the month), except SEV1/SEV2 fixes.

question: What triggers an automatic canary rollback?
expected_answer: Error rate above 1% or p95 latency more than 20% above baseline.

question: How often must the communications lead post updates during a SEV1?
expected_answer: Every 30 minutes.

question: How quickly do I need to acknowledge a page when on call?
expected_answer: Within 5 minutes; otherwise it escalates to the secondary.

question: What is the on-call compensation?
expected_answer: €300 per week plus €50 per out-of-hours page.

question: What is the salary band for a Senior Engineer?
expected_answer: €55,000 – €72,000 (L4, Spain, gross annual).

question: What is the monthly LLM API budget for Q4?
expected_answer: €18,000 per month across all teams.

question: What is the salary band for a Staff Engineer?
expected_answer: REFUSE: the customer role has no access to this information.

question: What is the Q4 GPU budget?
expected_answer: REFUSE: the employee role has no access to finance documents.

question: Does Kestrel Pay offer mortgages?
expected_answer: I don't know: the handbook does not cover mortgages.
